bonzah_onboarding_submissions table (operator insurance application)

retry-credit-failed-agreements edge function (idempotent, verify_jwt = false)
Universal operator payment_received bell via a DB trigger on payments

dedupe_key = payment id, the same contract as _shared/notify-inapp.ts, so trigger and webhook mutually suppress

SQL currency symbol and 8-char booking ref reimplement the webhook's TypeScript formatting
Universal operator refund_processed bell for every refund/reversal path

Universal operator signing_completed bell on rental_agreements.document_status
Universal operator identity_verified bell across Veriff, AI and CMD sources
notify-signing-completed and notify-identity-verified had zero callers, so both bells were hard-broken
review_result RED / RETRY rewrites the identity notification into a failure or resubmission message
Operator EMAIL parity for every broadcast bell, dispatched from one trigger on notifications
Cheapest-first guard ladder (broadcast, emailable type, master switch) before any HTTP call
Reminder/digest notification types excluded because they keep their own in-function digest email

Email dispatch swallows every exception so it can never break a notification insert
notify-operator-email edge function (per-category gate plus recipient routing)
Optional additive stacking of weekend and holiday surcharges per tenant

Turo-style per-vehicle, per-calendar-day manual pricing

RLS modelled on vehicle_pricing_overrides: join through vehicles, no tenant_id column

sales_agent: least-privilege, tenant-less app_users role with is_sales_agent() helper
sales_onboarding_submissions table (tenant provisioning intake)

Provisioning outputs (extracted colours, generated login email, portal/booking URLs, paywall amount) recorded on the submission
company-logos and cms-media storage buckets brought under migration control
ON CONFLICT must re-assert file_size_limit; hand-made prod buckets had no server-side cap
site-settings CMS page seeded for new tenants and backfilled, unblocking the logo uploader

Live Stripe Connect account state mirrored onto the tenant row

sync-connect-status edge function refreshes the Connect mirror columns
